messages:
maya_p (Product): Heads-up: Drafting Q4+ roadmap piece for routing / multi-region / multi-tenant isolation. Need alignment on scope for a customer-driven pilot (Acme). Can folks sanity-check minimal launch criteria, must-have policies, and rollback plan? PTAL by EOD tomorrow.

alex_k (Eng-Arch): High-level: must-haves = region affinity, per-tenant quotas, policy precedence. Defer cross-region live-migration to a follow-up.

sam_t (Infra): Ops constraints: egress costs + KMS integration are non-negotiable for pilot. Recommend limiting pilot to 2 regions and no cross-region KV replication for now.

julia_r (Sales): Acme compliance: strict data residency + VPC + audit logs. Sales timeline: they want POC in 8-10 weeks. Acceptance criteria must be contract-ready.

leo_m (SRE): SLOs to validate: p95 latency < 120ms on 128-token gen, failover < 30s. Need route-level tracing and error budgets per-tenant. Also require runbook for region evacuation.

maya_p (Product): Proposed must-have feature list for pilot: region-affinity routing, tenant isolation lanes, per-tenant quotas, audit logs + event stream, KMS/HSM support, canary routing + automatic fallback. Optional: live cross-region migration, tenant-level live-evac.

alex_k (Eng-Arch): Sketch of minimal policy DSL (v0):
```
policy:
  tenant: acme
  precedence: [region, plan, manual]
  routing:
    prefer: us-west-2
    fallback: us-east-1
```
This covers precedence + simple region pins. I can prototype a template in ~2w.

sam_t (Infra): For deployment: run the pilot on a small dedicated reserved pool (predictable capacity) so we can hit SLOs and isolate performance variables from shared hosted noise.

julia_r (Sales): Can we provide NDA + isolated POC infra? Acme is open to a short-term commit if we hit timeline. I can draft contract language for acceptance criteria.

priya_s (ProductOps): I'll own the test matrix + customer validation plan. Need effort estimates from Eng and SRE to slot into roadmap.

leo_m (SRE): Add to launch criteria: synthetic load tests (peak, sustained), chaos test for region failover, and smoke check for KV cache integrity.

alex_k (Eng-Arch): One more ask: cost-control hooks in routing (gate quantization / batching policies per-tenant). Low-cost mode for non-SLA traffic.

maya_p (Product): Good call — add a cost-policy flag to the spec (per-tenant defaults + overrides).

julia_r (Sales): Contract note: acceptance criteria should include observability contract (metrics, retention), incident SLA, and rollback triggers. I'll draft wording.

planner-bot: Reminder: scope survey responses due in 24h. Sync meeting scheduled Thu 10:00am to finalize pilot scope.

maya_p (Product): Thanks — I'll update the spec with this checklist and a minimal rollback plan tonight. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
